# Habibi Apps

> Habibi Apps is an independent mobile publisher and growth studio that builds and publishes mobile apps and games and helps mobile teams grow through ASO, LiveOps, store conversion, and practical experimentation.

Official website: https://habibiapps.com/
Contact: mailto:akour@habibiapps.com
About: https://habibiapps.com/about/
Sitemap: https://habibiapps.com/sitemap.xml

## Products

- [Balance Blast](https://habibiapps.com/balanceblast/): Physics-driven block puzzle from Habibi Apps focused on clearing lines, managing weight and torque, and keeping the scale balanced.
- [3 Match Latte](https://habibiapps.com/lattematch/): Cosy coffee-shop match-3 puzzle with three orders per shift, no timers, no lives, and offline play.
- [Mosaic Drop](https://habibiapps.com/mosaicdrop/): Relaxing 8×8 block puzzle with rows and columns to clear, combos, daily challenges, and missions.
- [What Came First?](https://habibiapps.com/what-came-first/): Discovery quiz where players choose which of two things came first; designed to play fully offline.
- [Void Stack on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oneapps.voidstack): Published Habibi Apps product.
- [Juha's Bad Day: Habibi, Run! on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oneapps.habibirun): Published Habibi Apps product.
